career.but_i_must_explain_t:
But I must explain to you how all this mistaken idea of denouncing
          pleasure and praising pain was born and I will give you a complete
          account of the system, and expound the actual teachings of the great
          explorer of the truth, the master-builder of human happiness. No one
          rejects, dislikes, or avoids pleasure itself, because it is pleasure,
          but because those who do not know how to pursue pleasure rationally
          encounter consequences that are extremely painful. Nor again is there
          anyone who loves or pursues or desires to obtain pain of itself,
          because it is pain, but because occasionally circumstances occur in
          which toil and pain can procure him some great pleasure.
career.to_take_a_trivial_ex:
To take a trivial example, which of us ever undertakes laborious
          physical exercise, except to obtain some advantage from it? But who
          has any right to find fault with a man who chooses to enjoy a pleasure
          that has no annoying consequences, or one who avoids a pain that
          produces no resultant pleasure? On the other hand, we denounce with
          righteous indignation and dislike men who are so beguiled and
          demoralized by the charms of pleasure of the moment, so blinded by
          desire, that they cannot foresee the pain and trouble that are bound
          to ensue; and equal blame belongs to those who fail in their duty
          through weakness of will, which is the same as saying through
          shrinking from toil and pain. These cases are perfectly simple and
          easy to distinguish. In a free hour, when our power of choice is
          untrammelled and when nothing prevents our being able to do what we
          like best, every pleasure is to be welcomed and every pain avoided.
          But in certain circumstances and owing to the claims of duty or the
          obligations of business it will frequently occur that pleasures have
          to be repudiated and annoyances accepted. The wise man therefore
          always holds in these matters to this principle of selection.
career.these_cases_are_perf:

          data that has been irreversibly anonymized or aggregated so that it
          can no longer enable us, whether in combination with other information

term.cookies_are_small_te:

          such as remembering your preferences and chosen items, assisting you
          to improve your site experience as well as trying to ensure that the
          adverts or offers you see online are more relevant to you. In and of
          themselves, cookies are harmless and serve crucial functions for
          websites. These “cookies” can be ided into 4 types each of which is
          outlined below..

These cookies are essential for you to owse our website and use its

term.these_cookies_dont_r:

term.b_statistics_cookies:
(b) Statistics Cookies. These cookies collect anonymous information on

          third-party analytics services which are for the exclusive use of the
          owner of the owner of the website visited. For example we utilise
          Google Analytics cookies to help us understand how customers arrive at
          our site, owse or use our site and highlight areas where we can
          improve areas such as navigation, shopping experience and marketing

term.data_stored_by_these:
Data stored by these cookies never show personal details from which

          automatically log in and we can provide you with better services and
          improve our shopping experience. If you reject these cookies, you may
          feel that the efficiency of owsing the web has decreased.
term.d_marketing_cookies_:

          owsing habits in order to recommend advertising more personalized for
          you. These cookies may remember your online activities and/or across
          third-party sites or online services, and share them with the third

          enable symmetric encryption of any kind of data; in practice, its
          primary use in the Windows operating system is to perform symmetric
